I have taught undergraduate econometrics and principles of microeconomics as instructor of
record and have supported Ph.D., M.A., and undergraduate courses as a graduate teaching
assistant since 2022. I received the **Harold Elder Teaching Award** for best economics graduate student in
2025, and **Outstanding Teaching by a Doctoral Student** from the Culverhouse College of
Business in 2026.
